description: Exhaustive Claim Registry mapping documented behavioral-playwright capabilities to implementation targets, independent oracles, and empirical audit status.

claims.claim: PowerHandPlaywrightRunner executes live stealth browser session and reports honest live success
claims.oracle: Must return status == 'success' ONLY when real Playwright browser launched and navigated to target without error; must never return 'dry_run_success' disguised as live success
claims.notes: Verified: Lines 141-149 catch exceptions during live execution and honestly report status: 'failed'. Disguised dry_run_success is never returned.

claims.claim: PowerHandMaster saccadic mouse path generation is strictly deterministic and respects seed argument
claims.oracle: Two distinct PowerHandMaster instances instantiated with identical seed must produce bit-for-bit identical saccade points without requiring global random.seed mutation
claims.notes: Verified: Lines 65-78 use isolated deterministic generator rng = random.Random(traj_seed) seeded from self.seed and coordinates. Global seed mutation does not affect trajectory.

claims.claim: All 6 stealth JS injection payloads are bundled and syntactically valid JavaScript
claims.oracle: Returns non-empty concatenated script string containing valid JS tokens; evaluated separately from runtime evasion efficacy
claims.notes: Static scripts are returned. However, static presence does not prove runtime browser bypass.

claims.claim: Level 5 Universal Worker Shield protects DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope and SharedWorker against prototype leakage
claims.oracle: Script defines Worker and SharedWorker proxy wrappers with non-tamperable prototype reflection
claims.notes: Script generation verified; runtime in-worker execution depends on target browser worker spawning.

claims.claim: Subpixel font metric normalization prevents DirectWrite/CoreText canvas fingerprinting
claims.oracle: Generates script intercepting CanvasRenderingContext2D.prototype.measureText
claims.notes: Verified script generation with deterministic noise injection.

claims.claim: FPGA PCIe DMA hardware bridge performs physical memory injection of mouse packets
claims.oracle: Checks whether physical PCIe hardware is interacted with or if fallback software packet synthesis is used
claims.notes: Unless /dev/pcie_dma0 exists on host with custom FPGA kernel driver, operates in simulated software packet serialization mode.

claims.claim: Absent optional provider raises ProviderUnavailableError without crash or fake success
claims.oracle: Requesting an uninstalled provider (e.g. patchright, undetected_chromedriver, browser_use) must raise ProviderUnavailableError with actionable install guidance
claims.notes: Verified in providers.base and adapter layers.

claims.claim: Provider matrix accurately reflects live environment package availability
claims.oracle: matrix[name].installed must strictly equal name's actual importable availability in active Python runtime
claims.notes: Verified: provider_matrix() inspects cls().info() dynamically and reflects true host availability. test_providers.py environment-aware check passes 100%.

claims.claim: curl_cffi AsyncSession impersonates Chrome 120 TLS fingerprint without headless detection
claims.oracle: curl_cffi provider can make HTTPS requests with Chrome impersonation when package is installed
claims.notes: Installed and functional if curl_cffi binary wheels match Python ABI.

claims.claim: SelfHealingResolver cascades across L1 (Exact), L2 (Semantic/ARIA), L3 (Fuzzy/Text), and L4 (Vision)
claims.oracle: When L1 selector fails to match, resolver seamlessly tries L2 ARIA role, then L3 normalized text similarity, without crashing
claims.notes: Verified cascade logic present in resolver.py.

claims.claim: Unresolvable target element raises ElementResolutionError after all tiers fail
claims.oracle: Typing into a nonexistent element raises ElementResolutionError; must not silently ignore or report success
claims.notes: Verified: raises ElementResolutionError('Cannot type: element could not be resolved').

claims.claim: CircuitBreaker tracks consecutive failures, transitions to OPEN upon threshold breach, and blocks calls
claims.oracle: After failure_threshold failed invocations, circuit breaker state must become OPEN and subsequent calls must raise CircuitBreakerOpenError without invoking wrapped function
claims.notes: Deterministic state machine implemented in circuit_breaker.py.

claims.claim: RetryPolicy applies exponential backoff with full-jitter on transient exceptions
claims.oracle: Transient exceptions are retried up to max_attempts; permanent exceptions re-raise immediately; sleeps incorporate non-zero jitter
claims.notes: Exponential backoff implemented with jitter formula.

claims.claim: BrowserPoolManager reuses master browser across contexts without launching a process per request
claims.oracle: Multiple get_context calls return distinct BrowserContexts backed by the same single Chromium browser process
claims.notes: Verified multi-context design; requires running Playwright runtime to verify process count.

claims.claim: Route-level resource blocking aborts image, font, and media requests by default
claims.oracle: When allow_media=False, routes matching .png, .jpg, .woff, or resource_type in ('image', 'font', 'media') receive route.abort()
claims.notes: Route interception setup inspected in pool.py and playwright_provider.py.

claims.claim: DataStorageManager exports records to JSON, NDJSON, CSV, and SQLite atomically without data loss
claims.oracle: Exporting N records produces valid, parseable files containing exactly N records matching the original payload
claims.notes: Multi-format exporters tested.

claims.claim: McpToolDispatcher registers and executes 20+ specialized automation, search, and security tools
claims.oracle: dispatching unknown tool name raises ValueError or returns JSON-RPC -32601; valid tool with invalid arguments returns error without unhandled crash
claims.notes: Tool schemas registered; execution requires underlying subsystems to be available.

claims.claim: Stdio MCP server communicates via JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol over standard input/output
claims.oracle: Valid JSON-RPC request produces valid JSON-RPC response; malformed input returns parse error -32700
claims.notes: Implements JSON-RPC 2.0 specification handler.

claims.claim: GoogleSuggestMiner queries autocomplete API with A-Z alphabet soup and returns unique deduplicated questions
claims.oracle: Queries with A-Z return deduplicated SuggestResult DTOs with keyword, query, and ranking position
claims.notes: Live network queries require active internet; unit tests verify parsing.

claims.claim: CSR Rendering Drift Auditor quantifies Jaccard token divergence between SSR HTML and hydrated DOM
claims.oracle: Given static HTML and live DOM strings, computes honest Jaccard similarity in [0.0, 1.0], flags missing H1, titles, and schema blocks, and assigns typed risk level
claims.notes: Mathematical Jaccard distance calculation verified.

claims.claim: PAAMiner extracts Google People Also Ask questions and accordion answers recursively
claims.oracle: Recursively clicks and parses accordion items up to max_depth; handles CAPTCHA walls gracefully
claims.notes: HTML parser verified; live browser accordion expansion tested against mock DOM.

claims.claim: NASDAQ ITCH-5.0 wire parser decodes binary order book messages with high-precision timestamping
claims.oracle: Decodes System Event ('S'), Stock Directory ('R'), and Add Order ('A') byte packets into typed records matching official NASDAQ specs
claims.notes: Verified struct unpack offsets and message byte boundaries.

claims.claim: Server-Side Prototype Pollution (SSPP) auditor tests JSON payload injection and detects prototype contamination
claims.oracle: Injects __proto__ / constructor payloads against mock endpoints; flags reflection without false positive
claims.notes: Auditor logic present; relies on target application vulnerability.

claims.claim: Out-Of-Band (OOB) listener captures DNS/HTTP interactions via Interactsh protocol
claims.oracle: Generates unique correlate tokens; verifies captured interactions; handles offline/mock provider gracefully
claims.notes: Mock provider verified; real interactsh service requires live network connectivity.

claims.claim: Frida native hook engine fallback never fabricates intercepted payloads when provider is absent
claims.oracle: When frida is not installed, spawn_and_hook returns False and payload callback is invoked 0 times
claims.notes: Pinned by regression suite in test_honesty_hardening.py.

claims.claim: Synthetic market data or simulated identifiers are visibly prefixed with SYNTH- and flagged synthetic=True
claims.oracle: Generated synthetic records have synthetic==True and identifier.startswith('SYNTH-')
claims.notes: Prevents accidental propagation of simulated market feeds into live pipelines.

claims.claim: WebAuthn Virtual TPM relay supports CDP virtual authenticator attachment without hardware token
claims.oracle: Generates WebAuthn CDP command payload and mock credential registration
claims.notes: Virtual authenticator is a CDP emulation feature; physical TPM hardware is not present.

claims.claim: Chromium Memory PID controller bounds heap usage and executes closed-loop pressure relief
claims.oracle: Calculates proportional, integral, and derivative control outputs; clamps windup; triggers relief when memory exceeds ceiling
claims.notes: Mathematical PID algorithm verified.
